title: 1 in 3 people can't find a job here. Top 5 highest unemployment 2025
description: Where is it hardest to find a job? Number one will surprise you. Real World Bank data, counted down from five to one.
source: World Bank, unemployment (% of labour force, ILO estimate, 2025), data.worldbank.org/indicator/SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS

segments.text: In one country, one in three people who want a job can't find one. Can you guess which?
Top five. Number five is Gabon. Twenty percent.
Number four is Botswana. Twenty-four and a half percent.
Number three is Djibouti. Twenty-six percent.
Number two is everyone's first guess. South Africa. Thirty-two percent.
And number one is Eswatini. Thirty-four percent. A tiny kingdom of one point three million, with too few jobs to go around.
And South Africa keeps getting worse. Twenty-three percent in 2000. Thirty-two today.
In Eswatini, that's eight times the rate in the United States.
How easy is it to find a job where you live? Follow for more money, mapped.
